mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates and declining unemployment signal accommodative policy and strong labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through improved growth expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in predicting SPX 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%), a rising unemployment rate signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the late-cycle expansion regime (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1.1 million units indicate robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through improved corporate earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1.1 million (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production increase exceeding 0.5% signals strong manufacturing momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate profits rise from higher output.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO monthly change exceeds 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payroll increase exceeding 100,000 jobs signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS monthly change exceeds 100,000 (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days through immediate spending momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above 3-month moving averages fails to predict positive SPX 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances (t-test p>0.05 vs zero return).
